title: Homelab status

panels.title: NAS uptime
panels.description: Red when the NAS booted in the last 12 hours.

panels.title: Beelink uptime
panels.description: Red when the Beelink booted in the last 12 hours.

panels.title: Grid off, 12 h
panels.description: Minutes binary_sensor.power_outage was on in the last 12 hours (HA).

panels.title: UPS on battery, 12 h
panels.description: Minutes the NAS UPS was not on line power in the last 12 hours.

panels.title: Watchtower NAS updated
panels.description: Containers updated by the last NAS scan (04:00).

panels.title: Watchtower Beelink updated
panels.description: Containers updated by the last Beelink scan (04:30).

panels.title: Watchtower failures
panels.description: Containers that failed to update in the last scan plus failed scans in 12 hours, both hosts.

panels.title: Containers restarted, 12 h
panels.description: Containers whose start time is in the last 12 hours, both hosts.

panels.title: Hyper Backup
panels.description: Enabled Hyper Backup tasks from hyperbackup-exporter. Overdue = last success older than 36 h (daily) or 8 d (weekly).

panels.title: Restarted overnight
panels.description: Running containers started in the last 12 hours: Watchtower updates, crashes, host reboots. A container that crashed and stayed down is not here; see Prometheus targets and Kuma.

targets.expr:
max by (host, name, version) (
  label_replace(label_replace(
    label_replace(container_start_time_seconds{name!="", container_label_org_opencontainers_image_version!=""} > time() - 43200, "version", "$1", "container_label_org_opencontainers_image_version", "(.+)")
    or
    label_replace(container_start_time_seconds{name!="", container_label_org_opencontainers_image_version=""} > time() - 43200, "version", "$1", "image", ".*:([^/]+)"),
  "host", "NAS", "instance", "cadvisor:.*"), "host", "Beelink", "instance", "192.168.1.131:.*")
) * 1000

panels.title: Alerts overnight
panels.description: Alert state changes from Grafana's alert history in the last 12 hours, all rules.

panels.title: Kuma not up, 12 h
panels.description: Minutes each NAS Kuma monitor was down or pending in the last 12 hours, sampled every minute. Maintenance windows are not counted.

panels.title: Targets down, 12 h
panels.description: Minutes each Prometheus target failed its scrape in the last 12 hours.

panels.title: Certificates expiring soonest
panels.description: The six Traefik certificates closest to expiry, both hosts. Renewal starts at 30 days; the TraefikCertExpiring rule fires under 20.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Prometheus scrape targets that failed their last scrape. The tiles below name them.

panels.title: Kuma monitors down
panels.description: Uptime Kuma monitors in state down. Groups are left out.

panels.title: UPS
panels.description: NUT status from the NAS. OL = on line, OB = on battery, LB = low battery.
Every Prometheus scrape target over the dashboard's time range. Red means the scrape failed.

panels.title: Monitors up
panels.description: Uptime Kuma monitors in state up, groups left out.

panels.title: Not up
panels.description: Uptime Kuma monitors that are down, pending or in maintenance.

panels.title: SSD life left
panels.description: Synology's remaining-life estimate for the M.2 cache SSDs. The NasSsdWearing alert fires under 20%.

panels.title: Days to 20% SSD life
panels.description: Linear projection from the last 30 days of remaining life. Capped at 10 years; empty when life did not drop in that window.

panels.title: SSD remaining life (60 d)
panels.description: Prometheus keeps 60 days, so this is the whole history.

panels.title: Running containers
panels.description: Every container cAdvisor sees on the NAS and the Beelink. Version is the image's org.opencontainers.image.version label; when the image has none it falls back to the image tag. Empty means the image has neither (untagged or a local build).

targets.expr:
max by (host, name, image, version) (
  label_replace(label_replace(
    label_replace(container_start_time_seconds{name!="", container_label_org_opencontainers_image_version!=""}, "version", "$1", "container_label_org_opencontainers_image_version", "(.+)")
    or
    label_replace(container_start_time_seconds{name!="", container_label_org_opencontainers_image_version=""}, "version", "$1", "image", ".*:([^/]+)"),
  "host", "NAS", "instance", "cadvisor:.*"), "host", "Beelink", "instance", "192.168.1.131:.*")
) * 1000

description: One page for the homelab: scrape targets, Uptime Kuma, disks, SSD wear, the UPS and running service versions.
